# Interface contract for C1 (as declared before the build)
- expected.json may list a finding as an object {"id": "<finding id>", "reason": "<reason code or null>"}. Within one case either every entry is a string (legacy: finding id only) or every entry is an object; with objects the runner compares the sorted multiset of (id, reason) pairs exactly, a finding without a reason comparing as null. Exit code comparison is unchanged.
- New gate reason codes: `document_duplicate_key` (a JSON object repeats a member name, at any depth) and `document_nonfinite_number` (NaN, Infinity or -Infinity anywhere), both as input_invalid, exit 2, verdict could-not-evaluate. Population ids must match ^S[0-9]{3,}$ (the scanner's own token), else population_id_unreachable. Any of --root, --revision, --population, --ledger given more than once (also in --name=value form) is a usage error, exit 64, with the gate's usual JSON usage object. The corpus walk is iterative, so a 1000-deep directory is measured without a traceback. Every os.open of an input document adds getattr(os, "O_NOCTTY", 0).
- The runner keeps its command line (`--root <tree> --tmpdir <dir>`), its summary JSON and its exit codes 0/1/2.

# Bounds
- You are a leaf: no subagents, no swarm, no second judge, no admission or verdict on the round. Executors may spawn at most one read-only labrat probe.
- Never mutate the fleet repo (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), sibling lanes, the lane jj state, the lane Git index or any tracked lane file. Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/pull/push or any mutating jj command in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin. Never run any jj command at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin; in the lane, read-only jj only with --ignore-working-copy. The only file you write inside /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin is your own report.
- Code that writes files or Git state runs only in your own sandbox: /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r30/w2/<YourName>/ (clone with `git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r30/w2/<YourName>/clone` when you need one; set TMPDIR inside your sandbox; never /tmp or /dev/shm). Deliverable files stay in your sandbox; name their absolute paths in your report. The L1 integrates.
- Owned sites: no live requests of any kind to the operator's owned web properties (ds4cc.com, *.kimi.page, *.kimi.pro, veigapunk.github.io and any host pinned in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/freshness-pins.json); work from saved snapshots. Never run /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/scripts/freshness-sweep.mjs, scripts/probe-delta.mjs or scripts/live_snapshot.py in any mode this round: freshness-sweep.mjs without a section flag sends live GET requests to owned sites and git ls-remote to pinned repositories (round 29 seat breach). Reading their source is fine.
- Network: no seat fetches anything except the reopen seats, which may GET only the URLs named in their item; GET only, that URL and pages it links within the same documentation site. Open sources by ordinary means only; never use a headless browser or any tool to pass a bot challenge, captcha or access control; a page you cannot open that way is recorded as unopened.
- Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/<that path>.
- Tooling: the operator authorizes installs and upgrades that help the task; read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first, use official channels, and record tool, version, channel and reason in your report. All pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide: no pacman, no -Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, no downgrade, no service restart; use uv tool, npx or an official binary in ~/.local/bin, or report the need. No install is expected.
- Do not message agent://all. Write plain English with no run-together words or private jargon.
